purpose: Mechanism J exploratory test: EXTRACTION_COMPLETENESS_VERIFICATION_PASS, Campaign V2's first write-side (extraction-time) mechanism, selected from the discovery-rebuild pool (v3) after the strategy-pivot triggered by Mechanisms G/H/I's consecutive failures. Calibration-passed (PM-20260824-9d020373) before this spend.
excludes_note: all 69 units used or examined anywhere in this arena to date (every prior mechanism's selection.json, recursively globbed). _abs variants excluded by base id too.

inputs_never_used: the calibration synthetic cases (which were hand-written, not drawn from the corpus)
selection_rule.method: deterministic: 1 unit per LongMemEval-S category (6 categories) plus 1 extra each for multi-session and knowledge-update (structural prior: these categories most often involve multiple distinct facts/events, a plausible -- not gold-referenced -- proxy for where write-time extraction loss is likeliest to matter), first-by-question_id-sort within category after exclusion.
selection_rule.size_note: 8 units, matching this project's typical replication-adjacent exploratory scale (RAW_PROVENANCE's own validating run, Mechanism I's confirmatory replication) given this mechanism's larger code-surface change (a real write-side vendor patch, not a read-side render transform) warrants a correspondingly careful test.
